{{Quote|I hired you two to watch my back, not play games. Now get off your butts and guard the stairwell.|Jenet spy|<ref name="dt" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Jenet''' was sent to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Tavri]] and his boss, [[Nim Bola]]. The Jenet used an [[Imperial listening device]] to do so. The spy employed two [[Ossan]] toughs to monitor the premises while he did his work. Tavri found the Jenet and his guards and took the Ossans out with two [[Stun/Legends|stun]] blasts. When Tavri asked the Jenet to explain himself, the creature could not do so and Tavri shot him [[Death/Legends|dead]].
